feeds.title: Munaluchi Bride Blog
feeds.description: Munaluchi is the leading multicultural wedding publication catering to women of color! Get wedding inspiration, pretty stylish brides, wedding planning from the most chic bridal magazine for women of color. For brides who crave culture and style.

feeds.title: Signature Bride
feeds.description: Delivering the most useful and insightful information in an 'up close and personal' format, SIGNATURE BRIDE is a multi-platform luxury wedding brand that fills an unmet need for affluent Black brides and grooms within the global wedding industry. Find Inspiration, advice, tips & news for couples.

feeds.title: LoveweddingsNG
feeds.description: LoveweddingsNG is your place to read about beautiful Nigerian & African weddings and love stories, also find inspiration and ideas to create magical moments in your story, and read about the latest trends, and more.

feeds.title: Bellanaija Weddings
feeds.description: Bellanaija Weddings is Africa's leading wedding site! Featuring real weddings, bridal collections, wedding proposals, honeymoon planning and much more.

feeds.title: Black Bride
feeds.description: Black Bride is the ultimate resource for before & after the aisle. Black Bride is the first on and offline multicultural global company serving all brides of color in the $200 billion dollar international wedding and events industry. Their Magazine realizes the future is now. As a bridal and lifestyle magazine, it showcases real weddings, creative pioneers, and innovators in fashion, wedding décor, photography and beyond.

feeds.title: Bella Naija » Weddings
feeds.description: BellaNaija is a lifestyle, entertainment, and fashion website. Read breaking, latest and top stories in Weddings. BellaNaija brings the latest news, scoop, gist, features, lifestyle, inspiring motivating stories, and music daily.

feeds.title: Hue I Do
feeds.description: Hey, Hue Boo! Hue I Do is a podcast for brides and wives about weddings, marriage, & life hosted by best friends Ashleigh & Toniah. The podcast was created to show more Black representation within the wedding media space.

feeds.title: Black Bridal Bliss
feeds.description: Black Bridal Bliss offers information on every facet of planning a wedding from engagement parties to honeymoons. Q&As with seasoned professionals, tips and tricks from bridal industry experts who want your business and even candid advice from married Black couples on what counts after saying I do.

feeds.title: Chip Dizard Weddings Blog
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Chip Dizard. I'm the owner and director of Chip Dizárd Weddings. I'm a photographer who captures special moments both on location and in studio sessions. I love to create a visual experience by telling a story through images. This gives the audience a chance to relive the emotion and sensation of an event. I've also been featured in many publications.
